# References

Put one file per reference in this folder before `/skill-refiner`. This README is the guide, not a reference.

A useful reference is an example of the intended output:

- a gold-standard skill to approach
- a prior good run (notes, a log, or a chat export)
- a verify evidence file
- a style or format example
- a rejected draft the next proposal must not repeat

The agent shapes a proposal toward these files. Evidence of how a skill was actually used still wins when a reference conflicts with it. An empty folder does not stop the run.
